_note: Guild rank from XP (game/rank.gd). Letters F..S, each split into X-, X, X+, X++ at 0/25/50/75% of the way to the next letter. letter_xp: XP to reach each letter (~8x per letter; S's steps span last_letter_span x its threshold). kill_xp: XP for a monster of each letter (x4 per letter, +power_per_sub per step) - so each letter takes about twice as long as the one before. Monsters below your letter pay lower_rank_xp per letter of difference. Power: power_per_letter per letter (x2), +power_per_sub per step, on health, attack damage and spell power. Titles: the noun, plus the first adjective whose measure is an outlier for your rank (1.0 = the norm).

unlocks.S-: a legend's title of your own
